• Conducting Network Penetration Testing (External & Internal) to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities.
  • Performing Web Application Penetration Testing to uncover security flaws in modern web technologies.
  • Executing API penetration testing using Postman and Burp Suite to assess API security against common threats including IDOR and Broken Access Control.
  • Delivered security assessments and detailed reports with remediation strategies for over 30+ projects.
  • Conduct Android application penetration testing, performing both static and dynamic analysis to identify security vulnerabilities using tools such as Frida, JADX, ADB, Drozer, JD-GUI, and others.

• Showcased proficiency in Active Reconnaissance, Metasploit, Nessus, Passive Reconnaissance, and a comprehensive grasp of OWASP Top 10, validated through practical application in hands-on labs.
  • Delivered a comprehensive presentation on Android security and provided best practices for users to fortify defenses against cyber threats.

• Led a team of 10+ Interns in executing Web and Network VAPT, fostering collaborative efforts to enhance overall project efficiency.
  • Produced 20+ detailed reports, meticulously outlining identified vulnerabilities, recommending remediation strategies, and prioritizing actions based on rigorous risk and impact analysis.
